action.left_arm: enabled; either arm or both arms may act
action.layout_note: dual_piperx has 14 arm/gripper controls; runtime.action_layout is authoritative.

reset.variation: none; seed is provenance only, not a reset randomization input
reset.round_plan: exactly five distinct target indices; permutation of Task Instance target_set

spec: task geometry constraints, scoring and deadline; fixed dual PiPER-X initialization
task_instance: inventory: object identities, drawer assignment, free-body poses and five target indices
episode_instance: permutation of the five targets; physical initial state unchanged

rules.score: 20 per completed instruction, each at most once; timeout unfinished instructions0; all five completed ends successfully; shared600s
rules.placement: existing fully contained, floor supported, released, stable .5s; drawer opened; no reset or object teleport between instructions
rules.language: English-only task_instruction, current-target round_instruction, success_condition, constraints and status. Top-level round_index 0..4. Advance the prompt in the completing step. At success or timeout, round_instruction is empty and round_index is null. Never reveal target drawers or future targets.
rules.arms: Either arm or both arms may manipulate drawers and objects. The target must be released from all robot contact before placement counts.
